title: Steady Take
user: Beginning instrumentalists practicing short technical passages who need feedback on repeatability and control, not only whether they hit notes or played fast.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA microphone/MIDI practice timer that records onset timing across repeated short patterns, visualizes variance, and lets a learner mark a take as controlled.
constraints: Audio remains on device; disclose microphone limitations; use Web MIDI opportunistically and preserve a no-MIDI mode.
summary: Measure timing stability across repeated practice takes
